info.description:
**See the** [Getting Access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/conversions/getting-access-conversions) guide **on how to apply.**

[LinkedIn's Conversion API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads-reporting/conversions-api) is a conversion tracking tool that creates a direct connection between marketing data from an advertiser’s server and LinkedIn. This API enables advertisers to measure the performance of their LinkedIn marketing campaigns no matter where the conversion happens and use this data to power campaign optimization.

This collection aims to focus on the new Conversions API and should be used with the **conversions-env-versioning** environment.

There are two conditions for successful calls:

(1) Scope permissions for [3-legged Oauth](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/shared/authentication/authorization-code-flow)

- `rw_conversions` (Read/Write)
    
- `r_ads` (Read)
    

and

(2) the user assigning permission holding one of the following roles in the Ad Account.

Ad Account Roles:

- `ACCOUNT_BILLING_ADMIN`
    
- `ACCOUNT_MANAGER`
    
- `CAMPAIGN_MANAGER`
    
- `CREATIVE_MANAGER`
    

\--All requests for the Conversions collection are in the Restli 2.0 format--
info.name: Conversions API

item.description:
1. Obtain user authorization with consent to create and manage conversions using `rw_conversions`, `r_ads` permissions in the scope.
    
2. Retrieve authenticated user's sponsored Ad Accounts where user has a non-viewer user role in the ad account.
    
3. Ask the user to select one of their Ad Account where conversion events would be streamed.
    
4. Fetch existing active Conversion Rules for CAPI in the selected Ad Account
    
5. Allow the user to choose if they want to create a new Conversion Rule or update an existing one
    

- If user chose to create a new conversion rule, otherwise jump to step 8:
    

6a. Create a new Conversion Rule with auto association to all campaigns  
(if successful, jump to step 8)

or

6b. Create a new Conversion Rule with auto association to campaigns based on conversion type (mapped to campaign objectives)

(if successful, jump to step 8)

or

6c. Create a new Conversion Rule with no campaign association (only required if auto association with all campaigns was not used)

(if successful, continue to step 7)

- Skip step 7 if the user chose to auto assoicate campaigns or update an existing Conversion Rule
    

7a. Fetch active campaign URNs to associate with conversion rule

7b. Ask the user to select specific campaigns (by default select all campaigns)

7c. Associate campaigns to conversion rule for campaign attribution and optimization

7d. For multiple campaigns, Batch Associate multiple campaigns to conversion rule for campaign attribution and optimization

- Send conversion events data (recurring)
    

8a. Stream conversion event to the conversion rule

8b. Stream multiple conversion events to the conversion rule
